brief_summary: To compare short-term efficacy and safety of Exubera vs Lantus in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus
brief_title: A Clinical Trial Comparing Short-Term Efficacy and Safety of Exubera and Lantus

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diabetes mellitus Type 2

Exclusion Criteria:

* Severe Asthma, severe COPD
* Smoking

official_title: A 1 Month, Open-Label Inpatient, Randomized Cross-Over Trial Assessing The Impact Of Dry Powder Inhaled Insulin (Exubera) On 24-Hour Glycemic Control Compared To Insulin Glargine (Lantus) In Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus Who Are Poorly Controlled On A Combination Of Two Oral Agents

primary_outcomes.measure: Variability of blood glucose over a period of 72 hours
